source: The practical consequence is that performance cannot be predicted from thread count alone. Ten thousand logical threads may still expose poor ready-work behavior if they all hit the same dependency pattern. Conversely, a carefully pipelined kernel can keep specialized resources busy with a smaller resident set.
zh: 实际结果是无法仅根据线程数来预测性能。如果一万个逻辑线程都达到相同的依赖模式，它们仍然可能会暴露出较差的就绪工作行为。相反，精心流水线化的内核可以使专用资源忙于较小的驻留集。
